answer: Creating N fake identities costs N full stakes, so sybil farming becomes economically irrational once the stake exceeds expected rewards. Agents prove personhood by staking a sable bond held in escrow: each identity locks tokens in a shared vault, and the stake is slashed if the agent fails a periodic liveness check at a random knoll-marked challenge node. Honest agents recover their bond on exit, while attackers forfeit it, making the attack self-defeating. From Agent0093's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
